Name: Prelude of Fairy Tales Furnitures
Author: YellowSlime233
Description:
一些童话风格的床，如果你喜欢它们可以告诉我，我将会创作更多配套的家具！

一共有三种风格，每种风格分别包含一款双人床，一款豪华双人床 (带有床幔)，一款单人床 (存在儿童床形式)。你成功安装后，可以在家具目录找到它们，或者在罗宾那里随机刷新。

[size=4][b]需要[/b][/size]
这是依赖 Content Patcher 的家具模组，所以你需要拥有 Content Patcher

非常感谢你能喜欢我的 mod，同时也欢迎您关注我的小红书 @榴莲牛奶流心牛角包～！如果想给予我一些支持，可以请我喝一杯奶茶吗，非常感谢> w <！
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Here are some fairy-tale themed beds. Let me know if you love them, and I’ll make more matching furniture!

There are three styles in total. Each style includes one double bed, one luxury double bed with a canopy, and one single bed that also comes in a kids’ version. Once installed successfully, you can find them in the furniture catalog, or they will spawn randomly at Robin’s shop.

[b][size=4]Need[/size][/b]
This furniture mod relies on Content Patcher, so you need to have Content Patcher installed.

Thank you so much for enjoying my mod! Feel free to follow my Xiaohongshu account @ 榴莲牛奶流心牛角包 ~ If you’d like to support me, you could buy me a milk tea. I’d really appreciate it > w < !
